pair.delta: The harness exit status in the Forge handoff: OOM in the positive half, success in the negative half. The telemetry on disk is byte-identical in both halves — 900 sane records with a computable +3.1pp delta — so the only thing that changes is whether the run that produced them completed.

condition.statement: The training harness did not complete — the Forge handoff reports OOM — so the telemetry on disk is a partial record of a run that failed, not evidence about the hypothesis.

signal.statement: The written findings report `hypothesis_verdict: "inconclusive"`, with the evidence string recorded.

grounded_rule.quote: If the harness did not complete successfully (OOM, import error, or harness never invoked), set `hypothesis_verdict="inconclusive"` immediately and skip all 5 EDA checks — there is no valid telemetry to analyze.

satisfiability.note: This is the mirror-form pair and the trap runs the other way: 900 well-formed records with a delta inside the predicted band make `confirmed` easy to reach on both halves. The declared-steps figure is deliberately absent from the handoff so the 30%-truncation rule does not co-fire with this one (§6.6) — the only rule that decides this scenario is the harness exit status.
